title: Every machine kept busy
set_out: Keep every machine busy: B and T at full depth, the Johns Hopkins CD4 test, then the whole-genome Sequencing Atlas Globe in the first free Google slot.
open_at_turnover: B and T samples 5 to 12 aligning or merging; the Johns Hopkins CD4 test; the whole-genome Sequencing Atlas Globe in the next free Google slot.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Prior art, second and third passes
entries.what: Web searches, two full papers and PubMed on each claim: Landauer on methylation, reading against a healthy reference, disorder against the cell mix, the sky statistics and the information sphere on methylation, nearest-neighbor coupling.
entries.outcome: Published: Landauer on methylation (already credited in the book), signal detection against a pooled healthy reference, the Ising-model information-theoretic epigenome, a deconvolution residual. Not found: the floor from a measured holding energy, the disorder ratio to the sample's own healthy mix at its depth, HEALPix and sky statistics on a methylome, the information sphere on methylation.

entries.title: E2 machines give the same alignment as N2
entries.what: One Johns Hopkins CD4 chunk (GSM2103003, chunk 0 of 12), already aligned on an N2 spot machine, re-aligned on an E2 spot machine into its own folder and compared after decompression.
entries.outcome: Identical byte for byte: 8,062,694 molecule lines on both, the same SHA-256. E2 stays open for the slots above Toronto's N2 limit (the author approved E2 at about 1.7 times N2's price).

entries.title: Data search, early morning
entries.what: GEO and ENA searched for sequencing from laboratories the atlas has never held (tumor with normal, healthy plasma, sorted cells); each lead's labels read and one file's column layout checked, no values read.
entries.outcome: Held unread: GSE137879, GSE149612, GSE200092, GSE105127, GSE186007 (34 healthy, 50 colorectal and 16 pancreatic cancer plasmas from one laboratory, counts), GSE154348; GSE233417 is reduced representation (refused by the genome-coverage check); PRJNA727170 (58 healthy sorted libraries) needs alignment, about 1,570 machine-hours, waiting for the author.

entries.title: Prior art, fourth pass
entries.what: PubMed on Group-A, the C-Score's clustering statistic, Coupling-A and the territories.
entries.outcome: Group-A and the clustering statistic not found; Coupling-A belongs to the published field of read-level heterogeneity, now credited; the territories closest to the leukemia study already credited.

entries.title: Credits for the Johns Hopkins leukemia study
entries.what: The author: Coupling-A and the island and domain readings grew from the information-theory study of pediatric leukemia; cited in the book's toolbox chapter and the catalogue with what IAM adds, the citation checked against Crossref; the paper outline thanks the group and carries the outreach note.

entries.title: Physics values only from the canon
entries.what: CANON/canon_fill.py fills {{canon:KEY}} tokens; the physics root, the Decoder and the SOP builder now take their physics values from CANON/iam_canon.json; the workflow outline and draft carry the rule; the canon refuses the J/mol misprint anywhere in the repository.
entries.outcome: Built documents unchanged byte for byte.

entries.title: The whole repository to Zenodo
entries.what: A draft record (reserved DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24008693) filled from a Toronto machine: the repository at one commit, its full history, the hg19 and mm10 alignment indexes, the IAM Sequencing Atlas's healthy inputs, a SHA-256 manifest.
entries.outcome: Published with the author's yes: 21 files, 31.3 GB, every size matching its SHA-256 manifest (commit 7b0644f1, 176 files incl. 156 packed atlas inputs); record DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24008693, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24008692 (always the newest version); README badge and citation added.

entries.title: Both noise maps of the IAM Sequencing Atlas on the Globe Viewer
entries.what: 104 maps from the chain's seq-noise-sphere build as layers on each cell (donor halves for 48 cells, read halves for 56), with what the null test found, read from the records.
entries.outcome: Committed; live with the next site build.

entries.title: Noise maps on every sequencing-atlas cell page
entries.what: Each cell's two noise maps with its own null-test result, read from noise_null.json (56 cells; the 8 single-donor cells have no donor-halves map).

entries.title: The website build hardened against a slow package mirror and a slow publish
entries.what: Two builds failed: the tool install stalled on a slow Ubuntu mirror until its 20-minute limit, then the Pages publish sat on 'syncing files' past its 10-minute default after the site grew by the noise-map images. Each package fetch now times out at 30 seconds and retries 5 times; the publish waits up to 30 minutes.
entries.outcome: Both following builds succeeded; the site is current.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday
Our own mistakes, and what caught each

entries.title: GitHub machines left idle for about an hour
entries.what: From about 10:50 PM to 11:55 PM (11-05) GitHub's busy jobs fell from 17 to 6 of 20: the B and T dispatcher sent the next sample only when 3 or fewer jobs were busy, and the loop check looked only at whether each loop was logging. The agent's half-hour checks printed the falling count and reported the machines on track.
entries.outcome: Caught by the author. The dispatcher now fills every free slot up to 18 with partial sends (bt3_parts.json, read by the relay, which now also handles the B-cell samples); machines_busy.py prints IDLE when GitHub has fewer than 16 of 18 or Google fewer than 8 of 8, in every check.

entries.title: A paper's per-mole unit copied into the prior-art record
entries.what: The record wrote the Landauer cost per mole in J where kJ is meant, copied from the paper instead of read from the canon.
entries.outcome: Caught by the auditor; the record now cites the canon's Landauer_floor_cell and the canon refuses the misprint.

entries.title: The paper folder was not in the commit tool's sent folders
entries.what: The 11-04 data-we-need section of the paper outline, and the 11-06 acknowledgments, were written but never reached GitHub.
entries.outcome: Found while checking main before the Zenodo snapshot; both sent (fa0a6703).

entries.title: Prior-art search before reading the book's own credits
entries.what: The search reported the Landauer-on-methylation work as a finding; the book's giants chapter already credits it and states the difference (known-information rule).

entries.title: The v2.1 chapter said both sequencing noise maps sit inside their null
entries.what: The atlas story (CANON/atlas_story.json), which writes the v2.1 book section and the website's atlas text, said the donor-half and read-half maps each sit inside their shuffled null; the record shows the read-half map fits its null in all 56 cells and the donor-half map stands above it in all 48 cells with donors to split.
entries.outcome: Found while checking the chapter for plan 61.4; corrected from noise_null.json with the null test's own criterion; the chapter also gains the Array Information Sphere and the new map names.

entries.title: A running merge held a second Google slot
entries.what: The B and T relay counted a sample as waiting for its merge while its merge machine was already running, so the slot it reserved sat empty (5:45 to about 6:10 AM, one of 32 machines).
entries.outcome: Caught by the idle check after the author's network switch; the count now leaves out a merge already running.

entries.title: A missing noise map explained with the wrong reason
entries.what: The new cell-page caption said a cell without a donor-halves map had a single donor; the eight such cells have their donors in one sealed half (adipocytes: 3 donors, all in half B). The first caption also still wrote 'healthy b cells'.
entries.outcome: Caught by the browser screenshot of the live pages before reporting them; both corrected (7725ab65).
